title: VTC Vetting — Vetters Resend — payload
description: A vetter asks the community to deliver their live vetter role credential again, over credential-exchange/issue, and an administrator may do the same on a named member's behalf. The community issues nothing new and returns the delivered credential's `id` and `validUntil`.

memberDid.description: The vetter to resend the live grant for, on an administrator's behalf. Requires the community-administrator capability. Absent: the request concerns the sender's own live grant, exactly as 0.1.

Response.title: VTC Vetting — Vetters Resend — response payload
Response.description: The credential the community delivered again.

credentialId.description: The `id` of the vetter role credential delivered — the same `credentialId` vtc/vetting/vetters/grant returned.
